name: old_hallucigenia_1977
description: OLD DRAWING plate (019): Conway Morris's 1977 Hallucigenia, upside down and back to front, in brown-ink engraving style. A little worm body walking on seven pairs of stiff stilt-like spines, seven soft wavy tentacles on its back, and a big round BLOB at the right end (~(260,-30), really a decay stain). Parchment fills, cross-hatching, transparent background, no text. Sits on old_drawing_card at the same centre. Anchor centre, fits x -340..340, y -200..200.
